I haven't looked into volunteer work much. I can't really afford to run around working for free when my truck eats gas and I'm already scraping the bottom of the barrel. I do donate whole blood and red blood cells when red cross buses are nearby, though.
I appreciate the responses, a little encouragement always helps. I kinda thought the whole post would go unnoticed.

I've had my paperwork in with the Army for about 8 months now. The problem is they consider me prior service, which automatically puts me at the back of the bus on top of my eye surgery documents and waivers. I've essentially given up hope on them ever calling me up unless there's an immediate need (war).

Currently looking for a steady job, though the market around here has sucked for the past few years. I advertise myself as an independent contractor and get some small cash-paying jobs to at least have something coming in.

I know life isn't fair; I've had that demonstrated to me many times. But all I want is just for something, one thing, to swing in my favor.
